Episode 224. Humiliation of the Poison Castle (2)
On his way back, Ragal pondered.

First of all, Kelliac Zifel was not an opponent he could handle in any way. Even after gathering all the poison of the Poisoned Lands, he couldn't even scratch him, so the result would be the same no matter how many times they fought again.
Even if Kelliac didn't counterattack and only defended, he was certain he would be the first to fall.
And he couldn't report this to Zito either.

'It's true that Lord Zito cares for me... but I lost miserably after fighting a human he asked me to look after like a plant? Then he might really chew me up and kill me. If I had won... would it have been different if I had won against him?'
Ragal soon concluded no.

'Considering the circumstances, Kelliac is likely to have a connection with the witch, so it's crazy to inform Lord Zito of this issue. If the witch cherishes this human and shows signs of anger... Lord Zito will definitely kill me. Damn, what was I thinking when I attacked him? Even if I had won, I wouldn't have been able to handle the aftermath.'
Therefore, informing Zito of the battle with Kelliac, by any means, resulted in only death, or torture followed by death.
There were many problems with asking for help from other demon kings.
From what Ragal saw, Kelliac couldn't be caught by just any demon king. It required the Supreme Demon Sword Paelito, or a demon king of his caliber.

'Paelito... I can't resort to him. Never to him! I'd rather die. Besides, I sneaked out the Runcandels behind his back. Normally, it's a problem I could easily escape from, but not this time. Because Lord Zito won't protect me.'
Among the top-notch powerhouses excluding Paelito, there were demon kings who would definitely help if Ragal asked.
But what if even they were defeated by Kelliac? What if the strongest forces that need to fight for Zito in the future turn to ash before they can even make a move?
All the responsibility was on Ragal.
By the time he arrived at the gate of the castle, Ragal acknowledged that his life was no longer in his own hands. It was a vain thing, but now it belonged to Kelliac.
Ragal was not the type to regret and tear his hair out at times like this. It was Ragal's way to keep going no matter what.
"Kelliac."
"Speak."
"Why did you spare me?"
"I spared you because you endured for 10 seconds."
"No, not for that reason... there must be a purpose."

"It seems you've organized your thoughts while walking. As I said before, I actually didn't intend to use you. But you foolishly started a fight and it turned out this way, what can I do? I have to find a way that's good for both me and you."
"Prisoner, the souls of the Runcandels... was it really not you, but someone else who stole them?"
"I remember the words Zito said to you on the day I came here. He sarcastically said that you are very curious, Ragal."
"Hey, from now on, don't we have to live together like a community of fate? If the events of today get into the ears of Zito or Paelito, and I get ruined, you will be ruined too, won't you?"
"Indeed, you are cute as Zito said. But unfortunately, no. Only you will be ruined. But you're behaving not too badly, so I'll tell you as a reward. Yes, it was me."
"Damn it, you're playing with me!"
"It's all up to you how you think. So, are you dissatisfied?"

"Well, the strong can play with the weak. What are you going to do with those souls? No matter how great you are, they are already dead, and without our demon's powers, they can't be used. Our children have completed control and indoctrination, so they are more so. Plus, those things, they were nobodies when they were alive, only named Runcandels, right?"
"I thought so too. But blood. Blood is really important."
Ragal naturally thought he meant the bloodline of Runcandel.
However, the blood Kelliac was talking about meant the bloodline of 'Ganesto'.
"Does it mean that they unexpectedly have value as hostages? Is Baekgyeong or the real Runcandel that desperate?"
"I don't know about Baekgyeong, but definitely not the real Runcandel."

"Well, it doesn't matter anyway, because what I was trying to catch with them was not the real Runcandel, but Baekgyeong. Is your friend Kelliac with the same purpose? Well, your friend must have been a natural enemy with Runcandel even when he was doing well."
"Ragal."
"What?"
"Although we had a battle for a moment, the Poisoned Lands would still be under lockdown, right?"
"That's right. When my order falls, all areas are closed within 1 minute. Plus, all the outsiders in the Poisoned Lands will have died from my poison."
"Can you choose the target to kill while having a mass murder range with your ability?"
"That's the idea."
"That's why my lost ancestor was defeated by you. I think you will be more useful in the future than I thought."
"It feels like just the other day that I became the Demon King and finally got the title of Mara... Now this Ragal has become a sidekick to you, hasn't he?"
"Didn't I say it would give you greater power than before, accept it kindly. Anyway, it's a relief that the lockdown was properly carried out. There's a spy, Ragal."
"...What? Spy? Who sent them?"
Ragal tilted his head at the unexpected remark.

"It seems to be Bisek's. They are the only ones in the Demon World who would plant a spy on you. He was one of the jailers in the underground dungeon. He was in charge of the lower dungeons, just above the bottom floor."
"What? Really? How did your friend know that?"
"Let's call it insight."
"...Insight? The level of insight to tell if someone is a spy or not just by looking at their face, isn't that something that only immortals have?"
"However, it seems that Zito does not have such insight."

"You don't know that, Kelliac Zipple. You may call Lord Zito by his name here, but he may be listening somewhere. He might just be amused by your antics. Do you think Lord Zito caught all those Demon Gods and Demon Kings by luck?"
"If Zito has such an ability, it would be more beneficial for me."
Ragal couldn't understand all of Kelliac's words. All Ragal could think about was the fact that this fearless human's backer could be a witch.
"Ugh, anyway, let's say there's a spy. The reason you asked about the lockdown of the Poisoned Lands is obviously because you now have to catch that spy, right?"
"I told you to think, Ragal."
"You mean I shouldn't catch him!?"

"I asked about the lockdown to find him in case the spy ran away. But there's no way he would have escaped the locked Poisoned Lands, so the spy will surely return and continue his jailer duties. We continue to give him appropriate information."
"Appropriate information that can be given to Bisek."
"Bisek would naturally hope that Inse will deal a major blow to Zito and the Demon World in this war. To do so, they would have to help Inse."
"...Ah! Bisek has already allied with Inse's forces, including Runcandel. So they can pass on information about our prisoners to Runcandel? To be used to capture Luna?"
"What you just said is exactly what a thinker would say. Of course, I still can't be sure if Bisek has definitely joined hands with Runcandel. It's just a speculation."

"Oh, then we spread information to Bisek about when to use the prisoners, and then check if Baekgyeong comes out. If Baekgyeong, who knows nothing, comes out to the battlefield where the prisoners are, Bisek did not join hands with Runcandel. If the real Runcandel or someone else comes out, they've joined hands?"
Kelliac looked genuinely surprised at that point.
"That's brilliant... Why did you act like a fool with such a brain?"
"Hehe. But I don't have the prisoners."
"......Have you become a fool again? You release the information to the spy, and I'll be the one sending the Runecandels."
"I see. Anyway, I've understood it all. If these Biseptus bastards really teamed up with the Runecandels...... what's next? How should we respond?"

"We'll have to plan that step by step. For now, let's go in and tell our subordinates about the situation. You were curious about my abilities, so we fought to verify them, and you easily beat me. My magic was flashy and caused a lot of damage to the toxic zone, but it didn't affect you."
"It might be good to stage it as if I won. There are holes in your body, or an arm has been cut off. Or your staff is broken?"
"If you want to do it that way, go ahead. Just keep in mind that I might retaliate without realizing it."
"Hmm, no, let's just say I won. Anyway, the underlings won't suspect anything. All those who witnessed me being pushed back are dead, so there's no problem."
"Declare that the prisoners were caught again tomorrow morning. Thoroughly disguise it so that the spy won't suspect, and even fill up the dungeons on the lowest floor."
"Yes, yes, let's do that. But Kelliac, how did you get them out? Is it the witch's power? Or do you have another power player on your side?"
Kelliac stopped and looked at Ragal.
"Speaking of which, you're still short of words, aren't you...?"
"Ha, if you want, I can talk high. I was once, no, until recently, I was in great shape."
"That's not what I meant."
"Because we're friends?"
Kelliac let out a soft laugh.
"Right, because we're friends. Now it's your turn to tell me what you want from me."
Ragal's eyes widened.
"Is there more you can do beyond sparing my life and saving my face? I'm so moved I'm crying!"
"Tell me. If it's a reasonable request, I'll grant it."
Ragal didn't hesitate.

"Paelito Belgasium. To become the first in the demon world beyond that unlucky guy. And I want to make Paelito lick my feet to barely survive. If you can make that possible, honestly, no matter what shit you do, I'll show you my sincere friendship."
Kelliac smiled wryly and lit a seal of fire on his palm.
"I swear by my name and fire. You will definitely achieve that."
